active_set_policy: Read active IDs from config/brand64-active-brands.json. The 2026-08-20 daily file contains the full current active 64 directly. INACTIVE_LEGACY_REFERENCE rows are preserved in historical snapshots but excluded from the current active aggregation. ZARA BR-00075 and SNIDEL BR-00076 use their 2026-08-19 initial baselines for comparison.
comparison_policy: Use prior daily/product baselines only where the same brand/product fields are comparable. Do not claim no-change when source freshness is insufficient. Category/listing pages can establish a current listing or discovery baseline, but same-SKU launch, markdown, preorder-state, or stock changes require direct comparable evidence. Scheduled events that had not started at the 2026-08-20 08:45 JST observation are recorded as not-yet-active.
offline_policy: Never delete a known product when an official page becomes unavailable. Preserve last confirmed fields and mark SOURCE_OFFLINE with the last confirmed date.
conflict_policy: Do not overwrite a fresher baseline with stale or conflicting index/search values. Record SOURCE_STATE_CONFLICT and require a live product-page recheck.
dedupe_policy: Deduplicate by official product URL and manufacturer product code when available. If neither is available, use brand plus exact product title only as a temporary discovery key until the product page is captured.
brand_id_policy: Never reuse an inactive BR-ID for a new brand. Inactive brands remain INACTIVE_LEGACY_REFERENCE with history preserved.
